summary: {person} must choose whether to move courthouse planning money into an endangered bus route.
realLife: Supervisor Justin Bielinski proposed transferring $1.3 million from the courthouse project to preserve Route 28, and the Milwaukee board rejected it.
gates: A member moves to transfer money between capital planning and operating service.
weights: A district served by the route makes the sponsor’s choice more immediate.
inGame: needs: capital line, transit amendment, transfer authority and roll call.

turns.what: The sponsor looks for a different source that leaves the capital project funded.
turns.writesBack: Close the rejected amendment and log any replacement.

turns.what: Capital staff identify the design work they must postpone.
turns.pulledBy: The transfer passes under applicable budget rules.
turns.writesBack: Update both appropriations and the project schedule.
